headline: Talwalkars Better Value Fitness Limited: Suspension of Trading
sum: Suspension of Trading - Members of the Exchange are hereby informed that the trading in Equity Shares of Talwalkars Better Value Fitness Limited shall remain to be suspended on account of Reduction of Share Capital pursuant to NCLT order.
